item.title: Markets hold more nervous ahead of European trading today
item.description: With the absence of the US jobs report today, it is leaving markets to fend for themselves in closing out the week. And so far, the more nervous and jittery mood all around is still permeating as we look to the session ahead. In particular, risk trades are being shaken up hard amid a combination of a selloff in tech shares and cryptocurrencies falling apart.The sharp pullback in precious metals also extended in early Asia trading, before a modest bounce back seen in the past few hours.
